faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Nagpur Data Entry Operator recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the AIIMS Nagpur Data Entry Operator position is 25 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 12th grade or equivalent with 5 years of administrative experience, or be a graduate in any discipline with 2 years of administrative experience. A typing speed of at least 8000 KDPH is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Data Entry Operator position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Data Entry Operator post is 30 years. Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST (up to 5 years) and OBC (up to 3 years) candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Data Entry Operator role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 29,200/- per month for the Data Entry Operator position.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Data Entry Operator post at AIIMS Nagpur.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Data Entry Operator recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Personal Interview. A Written Test may be conducted if the number of applications exceeds a 15:1 ratio.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to read it thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the Data Entry Operator position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website of AIIMS Nagpur or via the direct 'Apply Online' link provided in the 'Important Links' section before the last date.
